reason: Contradicts the task contract. The task description explicitly instructed the opposite: 'follow the local recording-stub shape already used in test_collect_repo.py's test_an_unparseable_remote_is_skipped_before_any_gh_call (a fake_run closure that appends every dispatched cmd to a calls list before returning a canned answer) RATHER THAN collect_test_helpers.make_fake_run, which only stubs git remote/gh and does not answer the branches/commits/local/etc. calls a full collect_repo() run makes.' The inline stub is what the contract required; make_fake_run cannot answer the rev-parse calls this test counts. Blake is the blind lens and had no task context, so he read the PRD's parenthetical '(the make_fake_run pattern)' as prescribing the helper itself.
